svg.text: The four recursive calls share entry 9. Their first commit moves BOS onto it, so all five returns read the commit stack top.
cyc 589: BOS reaches 9, the stack reads empty
predicted path after R5; other code
Addresses are 0x8000_0xxx. C1 to C4 are the calls at 0x8000_080A, R1 to R5 the returns of f. c and r are commits of other calls and returns. Read from out/fd07_calls_returns/fd07_calls_returns.fst.
